cohort: 106 exclusively breastfed neonates of ≥34 weeks gestation: 53 with weight loss >10% and 53 gestational age and weight-matched controls
finding: Lack of early skin-to-skin contact, higher EPDS scores, and lower LATCH scores were associated with excessive weight loss in exclusively breastfed infants.
mod_finding: Lower segment Caesarean section (LSCS) delivery was associated with excessive weight loss.
